objective: full-vocabulary forward KL + 0.1 * hard-target CE, final assistant tokens including EOS only
precision: FP32 parameters, BF16 CPU autocast training, FP32 evaluation
legacy_control: same adapter capacity and projected body; diagonal(old-scale) initialization only
evaluation: 12 held-out corpus conversations, 16 full-generation cases; greedy/thinking off/no repetition penalty/512 new tokens
loop_flag: >=40 words and repeated four-gram fraction >0.20; diagnostic, not a proof of looping
selection: use final fixed-budget checkpoint; no tuning or selection using held-out results
scope: small recovery pilot, not broad quality parity or a definitive test of recoverability
execution: two matched arms concurrently on local CPU; no paid resources
generation_grouping: fixed anticipated answer lengths, selected before generation
additional_reference: Recovered Qwen 500M-token checkpoint on identical generation cases; not a matched training arm

scoring_amendment.reason: Stock baseline exposed casing-only false failures for Yes and Teal; those prompts did not require lowercase. Case-insensitive matching applies to logic and multi-memory only, uniformly to all arms. Code copying remains case sensitive.
scoring_amendment.timing: after stock generation began; before candidate generations were viewed; training data, loss, and budgets unchanged
